title: A fluoride bridged {CrIII4DyIII4} single molecule magnet

synthesis.procedure: Under aerobic conditions, CrCl3·6H2O (0.13 g, 0.5 mmol) and Dy(NO3)3·6H2O (0.22 g, 0.5 mmol) were dissolved in MeCN (20 mL). N-methyldiethanolamine (0.06 mL, 0.5 mmol), benzoic acid (0.1 mL, 1.0 mmol), NaF (0.82 g, 1 mmol) and triethylamine (0.28 mL, 2.0 mmol) were added, giving a green solution that turned deep purple on heating. The mixture was stirred for 2 h, the solvent was removed to a purple oil, and the oil was redissolved in MeOH and layered with Et2O. After 2 days the MeOH/Et2O mixture was allowed to evaporate slowly; red plate crystals of 1 formed within 5–7 days (approximate crystalline yield 27%). Bulk analysis was reported for Cr4Dy4C78.75H111.13O33N4F4. The main text only names the same reagents and crystallization from MeOH, referring the full procedure to the ESI.
synthesis.temperature: heated, then stirred; crystallization at ambient temperature
synthesis.time: stirred 2 h; crystals after 5–7 days following 2 days of layering
synthesis.vessel_or_method: aerobic solution reaction in MeCN, then MeOH/Et2O layering and slow evaporation
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Solvent removed to a purple oil, redissolved in MeOH and layered with diethyl ether; slow evaporation afforded red plate crystals.

properties.summary: Compound 1 is an SMM. χMT decreases from room temperature, plateaus near 50 K, then drops below 10 K. Zero-dc-field ac data show multiple relaxation processes; the dominant process is thermally activated between 4.5 and 10 K. Open hysteresis loops persist up to 3.5 K, with a large coercive field at 1.8 K and a loss of magnetization at zero field. The 100 s blocking temperature is 3.8 K.

measurements.name: χMT
measurements.conditions: room temperature; dc fields 0.01, 0.1 and 1 T over 2–300 K (expected 64.18 cm^3 K mol^-1 for four CrIII and four DyIII)

measurements.name: Ueff
measurements.conditions: Arrhenius fit of the dominant ac relaxation process, 4.5–10 K, zero dc field, ac field 3.5 Oe, 0.1–1500 Hz; R = 0.99

measurements.name: coercive field Hc
measurements.conditions: maximum at 1.8 K; average sweep rate 0.003 T s^-1; open loops up to 3.5 K

measurements.name: blocking temperature
measurements.conditions: temperature for a relaxation time of 100 s, extrapolated from the Arrhenius plot
